summary: Porch Group filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement establishing an at-the-market program under a distribution agreement dated October 30, 2026 with StoneX Financial Inc. as sales agent. Up to 10,000,000 existing shares may be sold by The Porch Reciprocal Exchange, and up to 5,000,000 newly issued shares may be sold by the company, from time to time at prevailing market prices, including block trades, at a 1.5% commission. The company receives no proceeds from reciprocal stockholder sales and vice versa. Last reported price was $20.89 on October 29, 2026 on Nasdaq Capital Market under PRCH. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
